'''Business and economy'''
*[[Legality of cryptocurrency by country or territory|Cryptocurrency legality]]
**The [[Wall Street Journal]] discloses that cryptocurrency exchange [[Binance]] continues to do business within the [[People's Republic of China]] despite a formal prohibition of such activity by PRC authorities in 2021; WSJ says that more-or-less open trading totals US$90 billion per month. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/crypto-is-illegal-in-china-binance-does-90-billion-of-business-there-anyway-2a0af975#_=_ (Wall Street Journal)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Pittsburgh synagogue shooting]]
**The perpetrator of the 2018 [[mass shooting]] at the [[Tree of Life – Or L'Simcha Congregation|Tree of Life]] [[synagogue]] in [[Pittsburgh]], [[Pennsylvania]], [[United States]], is [[sentenced to death]]. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/pittsburgh-jury-condemns-tree-life-synagogue-killer-death-2023-08-02/ (Reuters)]
*At least 10 people are killed in a [[police raid]] on a [[favela]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]], days after 19 people in [[Bahia]] and 14 people in [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo State]] were killed in other raids. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-66387599 (BBC News)]
*A man is charged after [[Traffic collision|crashing]] a stolen [[Hyundai Motor Company|Hyundai]] [[Hyundai Tucson|Tucson]] car that injured 10 pedestrians during a [[police chase]] near the [[Grand Central Terminal]] in [[New York City]], U.S. [https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/kyle-fernandez-accused-of-hitting-10-people-on-east-side-facing-slew-of-charges/ (CBS News)] [https://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/nyc-crime/ny-stolen-vehicles-nypd-chase-drivers-charged-20230802-opq6iw6mfbd6femqdx3uqbzzhu-story.html (''New York Daily News'')]

[https://meduza.io/en/news/2023/08/02/mercedes-driver-rams-gate-in-front-of-russian-embassy-in-moldova (Meduza)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[President of Tunisia|Tunisian president]] [[Kais Saied]] appoints [[Ahmed Hachani]] as [[Prime Minister of Tunisia|prime minister]] after [[dismissal (employment)|dismissing]] [[Najla Bouden]], the first female [[prime minister]] in the [[Arab world]], from the role. [https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/politics/2544283-tunisian-president-names-ahmed-hachani-as-prime-minister-replacing-bouden (Reuters via Devdiscourse)]

'''Sports'''

**[[Jamaica women's national football team|Jamaica]] become the first [[Caribbean Football Union|Caribbean]] team to qualify for the [[2023 FIFA Women's World Cup knockout stage|knockout stage]] of a [[FIFA Women's World Cup]] after [[Tie (draw)|drawing]] 0–0 with [[Brazil women's national football team|Brazil]] in their final [[2023 FIFA Women's World Cup Group F|group stage]] match to finish second in their group.
